claims.cautions: Lean constructs no variety, atom, or atomic composition and proves none of the imported formulas: the projective-bundle formula for a projective line, the point calculation, the nef-canonical lemma, the classical cup product on a curve of positive genus, and the residue computation of the modified lattice all enter through the supplied dichotomy. The genus clause is vacuous once the exclusion is proved; it records the manuscript's intermediate step.

claims.objects: The same ledger and atom invariants, together with a supplied passage from a surface to a minimal model.
claims.hypotheses: The atom has even rank two, odd rank ten, and the residue discriminant of the displayed cubic residue matrix. An atom of even rank at least two occurring on a variety of dimension at most two is supplied to occur on the minimal model, and an atom occurring on the minimal model is supplied to have even rank at least three or to occur already on a variety of dimension at most one. The curve dichotomy of the preceding row is also assumed.
claims.conclusion: No smooth projective variety of dimension at most two carries the cubic zero-packet atom.
claims.cautions: Lean constructs no variety, atom, atomic composition, blow-down, or minimal model, and proves neither the point-blowup formula, the nef-canonical lemma, the classification of minimal smooth complex projective surfaces, nor the projective-bundle formulas for the projective plane and a geometrically ruled surface; each enters as a supplied premise. Additivity for disjoint unions is not represented: the statement quantifies over varieties directly. The headline row reaches the same exclusion from two bundled implications rather than from these refined premises.

claims.objects: Lean represents a supplied finite complex matrix declared to be the framed formal-monodromy operator; it does not construct the small even quantum connection or its Levelt--Turrittin monodromy.
claims.hypotheses: The matrix is already the operator for one turn of the original unramified z-disc, on a labelled finite-dimensional complex vector space.
claims.conclusion: The invariant is the sum of the characteristic-polynomial root multiplicities at exp(pi*i/3) and exp(-pi*i/3).
claims.cautions: The type records the framed operator only after construction; it neither permits nor models adjoining roots of z, and it does not prove independence of the algebraic closure.

claims.objects: Bulk shifts of the even quantum connection by a multiple of the identity and by a divisor class, and the framed formal-monodromy eigenvalues on the original loop disc.
claims.hypotheses: The coefficient field contains the Novikov coefficients of the connection, and the divisor shift defines a multiplicative character on the numerical Novikov image.
claims.conclusion: The identity shift changes the connection only by a scalar irregular twist and leaves the framed eigenvalues unchanged; the divisor shift acts by a coefficient substitution fixing the complex numbers, so it preserves the algebraic multiplicity of every root of unity.
claims.cautions: Not formalized as stated. The manuscript no longer routes this through the pro-Laurent gauge machinery that the companion formalizes.

claims.objects: Three nested algebraic branches are represented. The general coefficient-pushforward branch has effective homological and numerical additive monoids, a possibly nonsurjective quotient, compatible natural-valued degree functions, finite bounded homological pieces, and ordinary or completed coefficient families. The completed-convolution branch has one additive monoid with an additive natural grading, finite bounded pieces, and compatible systems of finite additive-monoid-algebra truncations. The completed numerical-ring branch adds finite bounded numerical pieces, a surjective degree-compatible quotient, finite coefficient packets, and additive scalar-weight homomorphisms for logarithmic Novikov operators.
claims.hypotheses: In the general branch, ordinary pushforward uses additive-commutative-monoid coefficients, while completed additive pushforward uses additive-commutative-group coefficients; its elementary cutoff-agreement theorem assumes equality of the two source families through the chosen cutoff. The convolution, `AgreeThrough`, and cutoff-continuity terminals use commutative-ring coefficients. The finite-packet terminal uses additive-commutative-monoid coefficients and explicitly assumes that its coefficient function is constant on numerical fibers. The compatible-family pushforward terminal assumes a surjective quotient with exact degree compatibility, finite bounded gradings on both sides, and commutative-ring coefficients. The standalone Leibniz terminal assumes one finite-degree additive monoid, commutative-ring coefficients, and an additive scalar weight. Its numerical pushforward-commutation terminal additionally supplies an additive numerical weight whose homological weight is the quotient pullback.
claims.conclusion: Ordered additive decompositions are finite and exact; convolution gives completed coefficient families a commutative-ring structure and agrees through every cutoff with ordinary additive-monoid-algebra multiplication. Completed coefficient families are equivalent, by mutually inverse reconstruction maps, to compatible systems of finite degree truncations. Under this equivalence, numerical pushforward is levelwise the ordinary additive-monoid-algebra map induced by the quotient, and the completed/truncation square commutes exactly. Addition, convolution, and numerical pushforward preserve coefficient agreement through the same cutoff, so numerical pushforward satisfies the explicit cutoff-continuity predicate with identity modulus. Finite-fiber numerical summation preserves finite-below support and cutoff agreement, commutes exactly with finite truncation, preserves convolution and the unit, and defines a unital ring homomorphism. Finite coefficient packets constant on numerical fibers descend termwise and fiber sums are cardinality multiples of the descended coefficient. The coefficientwise operator associated to an additive scalar weight is an additive homomorphism and satisfies the Leibniz rule for completed convolution; completed pushforward commutes with this operator when the weight factors through the quotient.
claims.cautions: The general coefficient-pushforward quotient need not be surjective. The completed numerical pushforward is proved to be a ring homomorphism when its monoid quotient is surjective; Lean does not assert that this ring homomorphism is itself surjective. The formal completed rings are coefficient families with a finite-below support condition. Their explicit compatible-truncation object and type equivalence are coefficientwise. Cutoff continuity is a quantified coefficient-agreement predicate, not Mathlib topological continuity; no topology, uniform space, categorical limit cone, or universal property in a category of topological rings is represented. The finite-type Chow-variety proof of bounded finiteness is supplied as a hypothesis rather than formalized. Lean assumes rather than proves numerical invariance of the finite coefficient packet, and it does not identify that packet with Gromov--Witten invariants. The weighted operator is packaged additively but is not bundled as a scalar-linear derivation over a separately modeled coefficient subring. Quantum products and connections, curve pushforward and normal-bundle pairings, geometric construction of the additive curve-pairing weights, and base change of the quantum comparison isomorphisms are not represented.

claims.objects: A rank-two cluster over a formal power-series germ, presented by matrices over that ring: the leading operator as a scalar plus a traceless nilpotent part, the grading operator, a connection form in a chosen frame, the compression of quantum multiplication in each base direction, and the residue of an elementary modification.
claims.hypotheses: The coefficient field is of characteristic zero, the nilpotent part has an invertible off-diagonal entry and vanishing determinant at the closed point, the compressed multiplications commute with the leading operator and satisfy the compressed flatness identity, and, for the residue, each formal partial derivative is its commutator with a matrix regular in the germ.
claims.conclusion: The nilpotent part stays square-zero and nonzero over the germ, the residue has a characteristic polynomial with coefficients constant on the germ, and two blocks with the same monic split exponent polynomial have the same framed primitive-sixth multiplicity.
claims.cautions: Fragment.  Lean constructs no quantum connection, Euler operator, spectral projector, or elementary modification, and does not prove that a compression of a connection to an isolated cluster satisfies the displayed identities.  The germ is modelled by a multivariate formal power-series ring rather than an analytic or rigid-analytic germ, and the passage from residue eigenvalues to the exponents of framed monodromy is not formalized: the multiplicity statement takes the exponent multiset as data.

claims.objects: A supplied type of geometric objects with relations for a rank-r projective bundle and a codimension-c smooth-center blowup; dependent numerical Novikov specializations; and intrinsic and specialized finite-dimensional complex framed-monodromy matrices.
claims.hypotheses: For r at least two, the projective-bundle relation is supplied together with equality of its intrinsic characteristic polynomial to the r-th power of the base polynomial. For c at least two, the blowup relation is supplied together with c-1 center specializations and equality of the total characteristic polynomial to the ambient polynomial times the finite product of the specialized center polynomials.
claims.conclusion: Lean proves the exact framed operation formulas: projective-bundle primitive-sixth multiplicity is r times the base multiplicity, and blowup multiplicity is the ambient multiplicity plus the sum of the c-1 specialized center multiplicities.
claims.cautions: The result is conditional on the geometric and characteristic-polynomial comparison inputs. Lean does not construct varieties, vector bundles, projective bundles, smooth centers, blowups, endpoint or specialized-center quantum connections, Iritani comparison coordinates, parity restrictions, numerical Novikov specializations, or the characteristic-polynomial block identities. No loop-coordinate root is represented.

claims.objects: Lean represents an effective additive monoid, a complete separated topological commutative domain, a multiplicative monomial-image function, a natural-valued length, and a natural-valued valuation.
claims.hypotheses: The monomial image preserves zero and addition, every monomial image is nonzero, valuation equals length on monomials, length is positive off zero and proper on bounded sets, and valuation is additive on products of nonzero target elements.
claims.conclusion: A typed certificate for the algebraic and topological core of strict Novikov admissibility.
claims.cautions: Lean does not construct the numerical Novikov completion or the associated graded ring; global valuation multiplicativity records the no-product-cancellation input but is not yet proved equivalent to the manuscript's domain associated-graded condition.

claims.objects: Complex matrix models of the specialized small even connection: an integral weight function recording the eigenvalues of the grading operator, a residue matrix, a parity-correction matrix, the matrix of Euler multiplication of a projective space, and finite-dimensional complex framed-monodromy matrices for a base curve, a rank-two projective bundle over it, and its specialization.
claims.hypotheses: For the nef-canonical case, every nonzero entry of the residue raises the weight of its column by at least one, the parity correction has square one and commutes with the residue, and the framed monodromy is the parity correction times the exponential of two pi i times the residue.  For the projective cases, the characteristic polynomial of Euler multiplication is the specialized quantum relation with nonzero line coefficient, and the conclusion of the multiplicity-one Euler block lemma is supplied as an implication from simplicity of the spectral blocks to identity framed monodromy.  For the ruled-surface case, the base carries the nef-canonical data, the intrinsic projective-bundle formula doubles the base count, and the specialized and intrinsic framed characteristic polynomials agree.
claims.conclusion: The specialized primitive-sixth count vanishes in all three cases.  Along the way Lean proves that a finite sum of weight-raising matrices raises the weight and that a weight-raising matrix on a finite index type is nilpotent, that the exponential of a nilpotent complex matrix differs from the identity by a nilpotent matrix, that a parity-corrected unipotent monodromy has only characteristic roots of square one, that the specialized quantum relation of a projective space is separable so that every maximal generalized eigenspace of Euler multiplication is at most one-dimensional, and that it has exactly the expected number of distinct roots.
claims.cautions: Conditional deduction.  Lean constructs no target variety, quantum connection, Euler multiplication, grading operator, Novikov specialization, or Levelt--Turrittin decomposition, and does not prove that a geometric framed monodromy has the displayed factorization or that a geometric Euler operator has the displayed characteristic polynomial.  Strict Novikov admissibility appears only through nonvanishing of the line coefficient in the projective cases; its role in making the specialized connection well defined has no formal counterpart.  The conclusion of the multiplicity-one Euler block lemma and the identification of the specialized ruled-surface module with the intrinsic one are typed premises rather than formalized arguments.

claims.objects: A supplied type of geometric objects with dependent strictly Novikov-admissible specializations and intrinsic, divisor-tagged, and specialized finite-dimensional complex framed-monodromy matrices, all over C; separately, the algebraic strict-Novikov certificate, an individual-class tag map, a finite injective vector family over an infinite characteristic-zero field, a completed coefficient family with finite support below every length cutoff, an injective integral divisor-pairing vector, an additive tagged-image map into an additive target, monomial initial coefficients, and direction-dependent initial-form detectors valued in one-variable formal power series.
claims.hypotheses: For every supplied strictly Novikov-admissible specialization, the final common-field polynomial equality resulting from the unformalized coefficient extension and algebraic-closure identifications is supplied, as is the final polynomial equality resulting from the unformalized divisor-equation formal bulk gauge. The individual-class theorem assumes that the tag separates numerical classes. The abstract finite-family theorem assumes an injective vector family over an infinite characteristic-zero field. For the completed tagging injection, the integral pairing vector is injective over an arbitrary characteristic-zero coefficient field; every monomial initial coefficient is nonzero; every direction detector sends zero to zero; and, for every nonzero completed series and integral direction, the detected initial form of its tagged image is supplied to equal the finite exponential-character combination on the formalized lowest support.
claims.conclusion: Lean proves equality of intrinsic and specialized primitive-sixth multiplicities and transfers intrinsic vanishing through every strictly Novikov-admissible specialization. It proves injectivity of the paired monomial/class tag on individual numerical classes. For every finite injective vector family, it chooses an abstract K-linear separator and proves finite exponential-character independence; for integral pairing families it constructs an integral direction. At coefficient level, every nonzero completed series has a nonempty finite lowest support and exponential-character noncancellation over every characteristic-zero field. From the supplied initial-form compatibility and nonzero monomial initial coefficients, Lean proves the tagged image of every nonzero series is nonzero, reflects zero, and is fully injective by applying noncancellation to differences.
claims.cautions: The vanishing result remains conditional on two final polynomial equalities over C. No source coefficient fields, common comparison field, embeddings, Polynomial.map scalar extension, or typed bulk-gauge witness occur in that theorem. The associated-graded tagging interface neither represents nor constructs the filtered target ring, associated graded ring, valuation, or geometric Novikov specialization. It supplies only proxy detector functions, their zero values, nonzero monomial initial coefficients, and the compatibility equality, and does not prove that they arise from the manuscript's filtered hypotheses. Lean proves the exact noncancellation and injectivity deduction from these proxy inputs. The individual-class injection alone does not imply completed-series injection; the latter uses the compatibility package. Construction of the integral divisors whose pairing vectors separate numerical curve classes, common algebraic closures, scalar extension of quantum connections, the divisor-equation bulk pullback, and compatible integral-loop-power finite-quotient gauges also remain unformalized. The strength of the row is uneven and the terminals should be read separately. Once the two final polynomial equalities are granted, the vanishing endpoint is immediate, because the primitive-sixth multiplicity is defined from the characteristic polynomial; that terminal carries no mathematical content beyond the equalities it assumes. The content of the row is in the other terminals: independence of finite families of exponential characters through an integral separating direction and a Vandermonde argument, nonemptiness and exact membership of the lowest-length support, and nonvanishing and injectivity of the tagged additive map from proxy detector data.

claims.objects: A supplied type of geometric objects with a predicate for points, smooth projective curves, and smooth projective surfaces; a nef-seed predicate; a named point and projective-bundle and point-blowup relations; dependent strictly Novikov-admissible specializations; and intrinsic and specialized finite-dimensional complex framed-monodromy matrices.
claims.hypotheses: Every selected object has a supplied inductive classification witness built from a nef seed, the point, a positive-rank projective bundle, or a point blowup. Nef-seed characteristic roots are supplied to have square one; the point multiplicity is zero; the projective-bundle formula multiplies the base multiplicity by the rank; point blowup preserves multiplicity; and divisor tagging transfers intrinsic vanishing to each strictly Novikov-admissible specialization.
claims.conclusion: For every supplied point, smooth projective curve, or smooth projective surface and every strictly Novikov-admissible specialization, the specialized framed monodromy has primitive-sixth multiplicity zero. Lean proves the classification induction, including the exact root-square-one spectral endpoint, and the final specialization transfer. A separate corollary proves that matrix involutivity is a stronger sufficient condition for the spectral restriction.
claims.cautions: The result is conditional on every geometric and comparison input used by the human proof. Lean does not construct the varieties, quantum connections, framed monodromy, numerical Novikov rings, grading operator or parity correction; prove regular singularity and nilpotence of the residue; derive the plus-or-minus-one spectrum from nefness; prove the low-dimensional minimal-model classification; construct the projective bundles or blowups; establish their monodromy formulas; or prove divisor tagging and specialization comparison. The human proof restricts eigenvalues to {1,-1}; it does not assert involutivity of the full monodromy matrix, which is strictly stronger in the presence of possible Jordan parts and appears only in the separately marked sufficient corollary. The manuscript now uses divisor tagging only for surface centers that are neither minimal nor geometrically ruled; Hirzebruch surface targets are covered by the direct specialized argument, whose formal content is recorded under prop:hirzebruch-specialized-vanishing. The Lean statement retains divisor tagging as one typed premise of the classification witness and does not distinguish the two cases.

claims.objects: An arbitrary carrier type with natural-valued multiplicity and dimension, explicit smooth-projective-complex and smooth-center predicates, typed blowup steps in either orientation, and specialized center contributions.
claims.hypotheses: Smooth endpoints; source dimension at most four; every blowup step has codimension at least two, the center-plus-codimension dimension identity, preserved ambient dimension, and the displayed additive operation formula; every specialized contribution of a smooth center of dimension at most two vanishes; and a composable typed weak-factorization chain is supplied.
claims.conclusion: Equality of multiplicities at the endpoints, obtained by proving each typed blowup or blowdown link preserves multiplicity and telescoping the chain.
claims.cautions: Lean does not construct varieties, quantum connections, comparison specializations, operation formulas, low-dimensional vanishing, or the AKMW factorization chain; those remain typed data.  The older abstract preserving-chain terminal is retained and is strictly weaker than the typed telescope. The manuscript states the theorem under the reconstruction-tail hypothesis and the divisor-tagging hypothesis only for surface centers that are neither minimal nor geometrically ruled; the vanishing of the center contributions is a typed premise here either way.

claims.objects: A rank-one block presented by a one-by-one pairing and grading matrix, the compression of a commutator by a projector, the scalar equation of the block as a formal power-series equation, and the characteristic polynomial of a framed monodromy that is the identity.
claims.hypotheses: Two is invertible in the coefficient field, the pairing compressed to the block is nonzero, the grading operator is anti-self-adjoint there, the projector commutes with Euler multiplication and annihilates the first gauge coefficient on both sides, and, for the scalar equation, the coefficient field has characteristic zero.
claims.conclusion: The grading operator vanishes on the block, the order-`z` coefficient of the scalar equation vanishes, that equation has exactly one formal power-series solution with constant coefficient one, and a block whose framed monodromy is the identity contributes nothing to the primitive-sixth count.
claims.cautions: Fragment.  Lean constructs no quantum connection, Euler multiplication, Poincare pairing, Levelt--Turrittin decomposition, or splitting gauge, and does not derive the characteristic polynomial of the block's framed monodromy from the scalar equation; the unit contribution is proved for a polynomial that is a power of `X - 1`.

claims.objects: Framed formal-monodromy matrices of a smooth projective variety and of its product with a projective space, and their primitive-sixth multiplicities.
claims.hypotheses: The framed characteristic polynomial of the product is the power of that of the factor with exponent one more than the dimension of the projective space.
claims.conclusion: The count of the product is the count of the factor multiplied by one more than the dimension of the projective space.
claims.cautions: Conditional deduction.  The premise is the conclusion of the manuscript's Levelt--Turrittin computation for the product, which rests on the Gromov--Witten product formula, the numerical Novikov base change, the distinctness of the eigenvalues of quantum multiplication by the first Chern class of the projective space, and the multiplicity-one Euler block lemma; none of those is proved, and no variety, product, or quantum connection is constructed.

claims.objects: A supplied type of varieties with a distinguished point, the projective spaces, the product of a variety with a projective space, and the framed sixth-root count of each of them.
claims.hypotheses: The product formula multiplies the count of a variety by one more than the dimension of the projective factor; a projective space is the product of the point with that projective space; and the framed monodromy of the point is involutive.
claims.conclusion: Lean deduces that the point has vanishing count and hence that every projective space has vanishing count, including three-space and four-space.
claims.cautions: The product formula is a typed premise: Lean does not construct varieties, products, quantum connections, or framed monodromy, and does not prove the Gromov-Witten product formula or the compatibility of the formal decomposition with tensor products used in the manuscript's proof of that formula. Involutivity of the framed monodromy of the point stands for the manuscript's rank-one trivial connection at a point.

claims.objects: A supplied type of cubic objects with a smooth-complex-cubic-threefold predicate and a finite-dimensional complex framed-monodromy matrix; Cai's rank-two indicial polynomial and the displayed characteristic polynomial with one factor for each primitive sixth root and two unit factors.
claims.hypotheses: For every supplied smooth cubic threefold, the framed-monodromy characteristic polynomial is supplied to equal the displayed four-factor polynomial arising from Cai's integral-loop-power block description.
claims.conclusion: Lean proves the indicial roots -1/6 and -5/6 give the negative and positive primitive sixth roots, proves those roots are distinct and each has algebraic multiplicity one while the two unit factors contribute nothing, and concludes that every supplied smooth cubic threefold has primitive-sixth multiplicity exactly two. A second terminal reaches the same value from a weaker premise: it assumes only that framed monodromy exponentiates the exponents of the reduced system, with two unit factors from the rank-one blocks, and proves which exponents occur from the block reduction.
claims.cautions: The result is conditional on the characteristic-polynomial comparison. Lean does not construct a smooth cubic threefold, its numerical small even quantum connection, Cai's integral-loop-power block diagonalization, the rank-two zero-exponential block, the two remaining rank-one unit blocks, or the identification of their direct-sum characteristic polynomial with the supplied framed monodromy. Lean also does not prove that the cubic threefold's numerical curve lattice has rank one or that the manuscript's numerical-Novikov convention leaves Cai's calculation unchanged. The second terminal removes the characteristic-polynomial assumption in favour of the exponent-to-monodromy passage, which remains external; the exponents themselves are now derived from the displayed connection matrices.

claims.objects: Framed spectral data of the small even quantum connection of a smooth cubic threefold over a formal even bulk germ: a point of the germ carries a framed formal-monodromy matrix and the multiset of formal exponents of the rank-two zero cluster, together with the total rank of the clusters at the nonzero Euler eigenvalues.
claims.hypotheses: The framed characteristic polynomial at every point splits as the polynomial of the exponentials of the zero cluster's exponents times that power of `X - 1`, the exponent polynomial of the zero cluster is the same at every point as at the closed point, and at the closed point the framed characteristic polynomial is the displayed four-factor polynomial of the cubic packet.
claims.conclusion: The primitive-sixth multiplicity equals two at every point of the germ.
claims.cautions: Conditional deduction.  The germ is an arbitrary type with a distinguished point and the spectral data are supplied, so neither the coefficient-field extension making the square root of three times the line variable a unit, nor the quantum connection, nor the identification of the supplied rigidity with the formal-germ theorem proved for matrices over a power-series ring, is formalized.

claims.objects: A supplied type of varieties with a smooth-cubic-threefold predicate, framed monodromy, and the product of a variety with a projective space; the rank-two indicial polynomial of the reduced small even system.
claims.hypotheses: The product formula multiplies the count by one more than the dimension of the projective factor. The first terminal assumes the count of the base variety is two; the second assumes instead that framed monodromy exponentiates the exponents of the reduced system with two unit factors, and derives the value two from the block reduction.
claims.conclusion: The count of the product with a projective line is four; for the second terminal this holds for every supplied smooth cubic threefold.
claims.cautions: The product formula remains a typed premise, as does the passage from residue exponents to framed formal monodromy. Lean constructs neither the varieties and their products nor the quantum connections, and the companion's separate projective-bundle formula is proved only under the reconstruction-tail hypothesis registered with the conditional framed operation claim. claims.objects: An abstract geometric signature naming smooth prime genus-eight Fano threefolds, their associated Pfaffian cubics, both rank-two projective-bundle total spaces, product with projective one-space, projective four-space, and rationality; for the unconditional route, additionally a birational relation on varieties and the ordinary Hodge-atom ledger of the atomic argument.
claims.hypotheses: For the framed route: the specified carrier satisfies the genus-eight predicate, its associated cubic satisfies the smooth-cubic predicate, both named total spaces obey the rank-two formulas and are birational, the cubic packet is two, and the named stabilization and rational comparison have the stated properties. For the unconditional route: each rank-two projectivization is birational to the product of its base with a projective line, the two projectivizations are birational through the flop, birational equivalence is symmetric and transitive and carries rationality forward, and the associated cubic satisfies the atom, ledger, and exclusion premises of the atomic one-step theorem.
claims.conclusion: The specified Fano carrier has packet multiplicity two and its named product with projective one-space is irrational. Independently of the framed route, that product is birational to the corresponding product of the associated cubic and is not rational, with irrationality supplied by the ordinary Hodge-atom argument for the cubic zero-packet atom.
claims.cautions: The geometric signature and the Kuznetsov, quantum, weak-factorization, and rational-comparison facts remain typed premises rather than foundational constructions. Lean constructs neither the Fano threefold, the Pfaffian cubic, the rank-two bundles, their projectivizations, nor the flop, and does not prove that a rank-two projectivization is birational to the product of its base with a projective line. The unconditional route consumes only symmetry and transitivity of the supplied birational relation and invariance of rationality under it; the framed route, which the manuscript states conditionally on the reconstruction-tail hypothesis and on the divisor-tagging hypothesis only for surface centers that are neither minimal nor geometrically ruled, carries the multiplicity statement.

claims.objects: A leading-term map from a coefficient ring to a complex vector space of graded pieces, a family of monomials of that space indexed by an abstract type, and a map assigning to every effective class the index of its leading monomial.
claims.hypotheses: The family of monomials is linearly independent over the complex numbers, the leading term of zero vanishes, and the leading term of the image of every effective class is the monomial of its assigned index.
claims.conclusion: The reviewer-facing type of certificates that a specialization is monomial, in the form its consumers use.
claims.cautions: Lean constructs no completed monoid ring, no associated graded ring, and no Novikov specialization, and does not prove that the associated graded of the coefficient ring of a center specialization is a monoid algebra whose monomials form such a family. The type records the properties of the leading-term data that the arithmetic below consumes, not their geometric origin.

claims.objects: The two monic quartics displayed in the statement, in two complex parameters standing for the specialized values of the fibre class and of the section class shifted by the integer part of half the index in fibres, and the universal discriminant of a monic quartic in its coefficients.
claims.hypotheses: None beyond the displayed coefficients; the even splitting takes square roots of the two parameters.
claims.conclusion: Lean evaluates the universal quartic discriminant on the coefficients of each displayed quartic, obtaining two to the twenty-fourth times the square of the product of the two parameters and their difference in the even case, and minus the square of that product times the cube of the displayed quadratic in the odd case, and exhibits the even quartic as the product of the four linear factors with roots twice the four sums and differences of the square roots.
claims.cautions: The manuscript's conclusion is that these quartics are the characteristic polynomial of Euler multiplication on the even cohomology of a Hirzebruch surface. Lean constructs no variety, no quantum cohomology, no Novikov specialization and no Euler multiplication, and proves nothing about the deformation reduction to index at most one or about the toric presentation there; the quartics enter as displayed polynomials. The symbolic derivation of the quartics from the presented ring, together with its cross-checks, is the registered evidence bundle hirzebruch-euler-spectrum, generated by verification/hirzebruch_euler_spectrum.py and recorded in verification/hirzebruch-euler-spectrum.json.

claims.objects: A four-by-four complex matrix standing for Euler multiplication, its characteristic polynomial, the maximal generalized eigenspaces of the associated endomorphism, and a two-by-two complex matrix standing for a rank-two spectral block.
claims.hypotheses: The characteristic polynomial of the matrix is the displayed even or odd quartic; both specialized values are nonzero; off the degeneracy locus the corresponding separation hypothesis holds, that is the two values differ, respectively the quadratic in them is nonzero; on the locus the values are supplied in parametrized form, the common value as a square in the even case and as minus twenty-seven times the square of a scale parameter against sixteen times that parameter in the odd case; and for the rank-two statement the block has trace twice and determinant the square of a single eigenvalue.
claims.conclusion: Lean proves that the discriminant vanishes exactly when the two values agree in the even case and exactly on the displayed quadratic locus in the odd case; that off those loci every maximal generalized eigenspace has dimension at most one; that the odd parametrization covers its whole locus; that on each locus the quartic is a squared linear factor times a quadratic whose two roots differ from the repeated one; and hence that no maximal generalized eigenspace has dimension more than two, the one at the repeated root has dimension exactly two, and the two others have dimension exactly one. It also proves that the centered matrix of a rank-two block squares to zero.
claims.cautions: The identification of the algebraic multiplicity of an eigenvalue with the dimension of the maximal generalized eigenspace is proved for the supplied matrix; that the supplied matrix is Euler multiplication of a Hirzebruch surface is not. The odd degeneracy locus is parametrized by writing the section value as sixteen times a scale parameter, which is no restriction over the complex numbers and is recorded as a separate statement. Lean proves the nilpotent part of a rank-two block to be square-zero and does not prove such a block semisimple; the evidence bundle records the stronger computed fact that the block is semisimple at the degeneracy locus, which the manuscript does not use. The manuscript's closing sentence, that case (b) does not arise for a center specialization when the index is at least one while it can for the quadric surface, is a statement about the specializations of the blowup comparison and is recorded under lem:center-maps-monomial, lem:center-specialization-nondegenerate and prop:hirzebruch-specialized-vanishing, not here. The first of those three is absent from Lean, so at index one the graded-monomiality the closing sentence needs is argued in the manuscript only.

claims.objects: The algebraic core of a strictly Novikov-admissible specialization: an effective numerical monoid, a complete separated topological domain, the monomial image map, its length and valuation functions; and, for the third statement, a leading-term map together with a linearly independent family of monomials.
claims.hypotheses: The fibre class and the section class are nonzero, the shift is positive, and the two coefficients are units of the coefficient ring; for the third statement the leading term of the combination is the corresponding combination of two members of the family.
claims.conclusion: Lean derives from the valuation law that lengths are additive and multiples of a class have multiples of its length, that units and negatives leave a valuation unchanged, and hence that the specialized fibre value differs from the specialized shifted-section value and that no unit combination of the fibre value with the square of the shifted-section value vanishes. Independently of any shift, it proves that a combination of two members of a linearly independent family with coefficients two hundred fifty-six and twenty-seven cannot vanish, since for distinct members independence forces the first coefficient to vanish and for a common member the nonzero coefficient sum does.
claims.cautions: That the center specializations of the blowup comparison have this algebraic core, and that their associated graded is a monoid algebra whose monomials form a linearly independent family containing the leading term of every effective monomial, are manuscript statements about the geometry and are not formalized. The additivity of the leading-term map on two summands of equal valuation enters as a hypothesis.

claims.objects: Framed monodromy matrices with their primitive-sixth multiplicity, a four-by-four complex matrix standing for Euler multiplication on the even cohomology of the surface, and two two-by-two matrices standing for Euler multiplication on the two projective-line factors of the quadric surface.
claims.hypotheses: The characteristic polynomial of Euler multiplication is the displayed quartic, or, for the quadric surface, is the specialized quantum relation of a projective line on each factor; both specialized values are nonzero; the even or odd separation hypothesis holds, that is the two values differ, respectively the quadratic in them is nonzero; and the conclusion of the multiplicity-one Euler block lemma is supplied, in the tensor form for the quadric surface and in the direct form otherwise.
claims.conclusion: Lean proves that the Euler spectra are simple, applies the supplied implication to obtain a framed characteristic polynomial that is a power of the linear polynomial with root one, and concludes that the primitive-sixth multiplicity vanishes.
claims.cautions: No variety, product, quantum connection, Novikov specialization or Levelt--Turrittin decomposition is constructed. The Gromov--Witten product formula, the compatibility of the formal decomposition with tensor products, and the multiplicity-one Euler block lemma enter as hypotheses; the quadric statement assumes no relation between the two specialized values, which is what makes it cover the specializations identifying the two rulings.

claims.objects: The numerical Novikov specializations of the center summands of the blowup comparison, and the associated graded of their coefficient ring.
claims.hypotheses: None beyond the displayed form of those specializations.
claims.conclusion: Each of them is monomial: the associated graded is a Laurent monoid ring whose monomials form a complex basis, and the image of every effective monomial is one of them with coefficient one.
claims.cautions: No terminal. Lean constructs no completed monoid ring, no associated graded ring, and no blowup comparison, so the statement that the center specializations have monomial associated graded image has no formal counterpart; the type of monomial-specialization certificates recorded under def:monomial-specialization records only the properties such data must have.
